name: Venue
tagline: Your café, bistro, fast food or bar on its own server: the menu with VAT rates and the 14 allergens, staff with PINs on a shared tablet, and a public menu for your guests.
features: Hungary and Romania ready with their currency and VAT rates; any other country set up by hand
A menu in categories with prices, VAT rates, where each item is prepared and the 14 EU allergens
Staff with a role and a PIN for the shared tablet, without accounts of their own
Tablets enabled by the owner and disabled at once when one is lost
A public menu for guests, for a QR code on the tables
audience: Cafés, bistros, fast food places, small restaurants and bars.
